items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: You didn't happen to tell Ray Dowell, who put on a program a little while ago, that you were in that program, did you?

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. I'll stop Evans right there. We can find that out.

Mm-hmm. You didn't happen to tell Ray Dowell, who put on a program a little while ago, that you were in that program, did you? Well, were you in the first OK Record Festival or in the second? Because there were two, one in February and one a little later in spring, maybe in April or May.

Do you remember? Yeah. Well, I must have, I wasn't in but one. So I must have been in the later one then, because I think it was, I don't think it was cool when I was in it, and I think it must have been, I must have been in the later one.
